title: Stale unit-test name: missed_superframe_is_noop_outside_recovering (desync.rs:616) now that SYNCED tracks misses
description: Codereview pass 2/3 on kvfd (8c1e26b1b5) surfaced a pre-existing naming nit: rust/lichen-core/src/desync.rs:616 test `missed_superframe_is_noop_outside_recovering` drives on_missed_superframe() from SYNCED and asserts Synced — but since R-02a-081 landed (SYNCED_MISSED_BEACON_DESYNC), SYNCED is NOT a no-op: the missed_superframes counter advances (1, 2) and only the state stays Synced below threshold. The test still passes but its name/intent is stale and could mislead future edits (e.g. someone 'fixing' it to expect a counter of 0). Suggested fix: rename to e.g. `missed_superframe_below_threshold_stays_synced` and assert the counter advance (1 then 2) to pin the R-02a-081 sub-threshold behavior; also note the DESYNCED-arm half is a true no-op. P4 readability.
